newsitem.title: LATVIA: PARLIAMENT PASSES LAW ON MOTOR INSURANCE.
newsitem.headline: PARLIAMENT PASSES LAW ON MOTOR INSURANCE.

text.p: Parliament on Thursday passed the law on compulsory motor insurance, which is now comes into force although people do not have to get the compulsory insurance until next year.
The law was accepted with 63 votes in favour and 12 against.
The tariffs accepted by the parliamentarians are still on average some 20 percent below the levels proposed by the Association of Insurers.
Insurance costs for a car will amount to 31 lats and 55 lats for a lorry vs 41 lats and 72 lats proposed by the insurers repectively.
The parliament also agreed to have the government decide on actual maximum compensation levels while the basic tariffs will be set by the parliament.
